concerns.text: FR-004 mandates McNemar's tests for accuracy comparisons. McNemar's test requires paired binary outcomes on the same items under two conditions. In this study each participant sees different buggy methods per condition (Latin‑square design), so the data are not paired. Using McNemar's therefore violates its assumptions and yields invalid significance results. A mixed‑effects logistic regression (or generalized estimating equations) that accounts for participant random effects and the non‑paired nature of tasks would be appropriate.
